title: Modern Retractable Wall Hook 2-1/2-Inch Extendable | Brushed Bronze | Retractable Hooks And Garment Rods | Allied Brass
short_title: Modern Retractable Wall Hook, 2-1/2-Inch Extension, Brushed Bronze
description:
Need hanging space in your bathroom without a hook sticking out all the time? This modern retractable wall hook extends when you need it, then pushes back in to stay out of the way when not in use in Brushed Bronze, which features warm, earthy tones with a softly textured surface that adds depth to traditional and transitional bathrooms.

Highlights:
- Brushed Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Secure everyday storage—rated to hold up to 15 pounds
- Match your bathroom hardware—part of the Retractable Hooks and Garment Rods collection and offered in many finish options
- Personalize the look—knob tip can be removed and replaced with your own cabinet knob

Specs & Installation:
- Hanging extension: 2-1/2 inches
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 2 x 2 x 3.75 inches
- Weight capacity: up to 15 lb
- Wall type: fits standard interior walls
- Installation: requires drilling one 3/4-inch diameter hole through drywall plus three small holes; installs with included toggle bolts and mounting hardware

_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2'' of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor. Gives you the option to remove the knob tip supplied with the item and replace it with a cabinet knob of your own, allowing you to match existing ones in the room!
